question: In the RSC Advances study of biochar loading in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids for CO2 adsorption, at what temperature and for how long was the Teflon-lined autoclave held in the solvothermal synthesis of the hybrids?
rendered: The Teflon-lined autoclave was maintained at 210 °C for 3.5 h.
